english.title: Fail to keep regulation 40(1) records for at least four years and make available to appropriate authority (from 2019)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the operator of a scheme, failed to keep a record, namely **(..SPECIFY RECORD..), required to be kept under regulation 41(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013, for a period of at least four years commencing on the date on which the record was made and make it available to the appropriate authority on demand
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 41(2), 90(3)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the operator of a scheme
failed to keep regulation 40(1) records for at least four years from date record made
and make them available to appropriate authority on demand

english.notes: This regulation comes into effect on 1st January 2019
